method: Unchanged original classes on the MobMoveProbe/ChickenProbe/DifficultyProbe world double, extended with a wooden door at x 6 z 5 (y 1 and 2), a chicken search list filtered through the real selector, and a log of aux sound effects, destroyBlockInWorldPartially and setBlockToAir calls. seat/dismount/cycle/remount: Entity.mountEntity, updateRiderPosition, getMountedYOffset, getYOffset. chicken: EntityChicken jockey flag, experience, canDespawn, NBT and egg laying. spiderJockey: EntitySpider.onSpawnWithEgg(null) per seed and difficulty. chickenJockey: EntityZombie.onSpawnWithEgg with a forced child group. canBreakDoors/breakDoor/griefing: EntityZombie.setBreakDoorsAItask and EntityAIBreakDoor shouldExecute/startExecuting/continueExecuting/updateTask for up to 241 ticks.
